digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: under DC's eventually-consistent Lucene index, a crash during create produces a keyless-pending binding entry; recover_pending searches and on a miss unbinds, then create_one searches the same label and on a miss creates a duplicate issue

fixing only recover_pending to leave the entry pending does not prevent the duplicate because the create gate at outbound_differ only consults get_jira_key(local_id), which is None for both absent and keyless-pending entries, making the pending entry invisible to the gate

the duplicate-preventing change must be at the create gate in dispatch_one.create_one: defer (not drop) the create while a keyless-pending binding is younger than an index-lag grace window, while recover_pending increments search_miss_count on negatives and unbinds only after >= 3 consecutive misses AND entry age > grace period

a single negative JQL search cannot prove non-existence under index lag, but multiple misses over time can corroborate absence; the keyed-pending branch avoids search entirely via deterministic key lookup and must remain unchanged

after index catches up and search returns the issue, the pending binding must confirm against the existing issue without creating a second one; a genuinely-absent ticket must still unbind after corroboration and be re-creatable so no ticket strands pending forever
the fix applies to both Cloud and DC since both have eventual consistency; the cost on Cloud is a deferred create in a rare crash-recovery path
